{"program":"domain(person,[lennon,louisa,karim]).

% Lennon has feathers.
axiom(s1, feathers(lennon)).

% If Lennon either eats pollen or sips sap (but not both), then he collects nectar.
axiom(s2, rule([xor(eats_pollen(lennon), sips_sap(lennon))], collects_nectar(lennon))).

% Lennon does not locate food.
axiom(s3, not(locates_food(lennon))).

% Lennon does not avoid predators.
axiom(s4, not(avoids_predators(lennon))).

% Any insect that finds shelter either avoids predators or locates food (or both).
axiom(s5, rule([and(insect(X), finds_shelter(X))], or(avoids_predators(X), locates_food(X)))).

% If Lennon has feathers, then he spreads seeds and flies efficiently.
axiom(s6, rule([feathers(lennon)], and(spreads_seeds(lennon), flies_efficiently(lennon)))).

% If Lennon hibernates during winter, then he migrates seasonally.
axiom(s7, rule([hibernates_during_winter(lennon)], migrates_seasonally(lennon))).

% Louisa does not avoid predators.
axiom(s8, not(avoids_predators(louisa))).

% Lennon finds shelter or migrates seasonally.
axiom(s9, or(finds_shelter(lennon), migrates_seasonally(lennon))).

% If Karim has feathers, then he spreads seeds and flies efficiently.
axiom(s10, rule([feathers(karim)], and(spreads_seeds(karim), flies_efficiently(karim)))).

% Lennon either collects nectar or spreads seeds, but not both.
axiom(s11, xor(collects_nectar(lennon), spreads_seeds(lennon))).","query":"labelled_explanation(not(pollinates_flowers(lennon)), Status, Package)"}
